title: Find deterministic mock approach for Gamma API in CI
notes: Spun out of gamma-cli-ic6 (closed without AIMock integration). AIMock (@copilotkit/aimock) is purpose-built for LLM provider chat-completion APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini) — it normalizes incoming requests to Anthropic's /v1/messages shape before fixture matching. The Gamma public API (https://public-api.gamma.app/v1.0) is a REST content-generation API with POST /generations + polling GET /generations/:id; AIMock has no understanding of that protocol. Options to evaluate: (1) hand-rolled tiny HTTP fixture server, (2) Pact contract tests, (3) MSW node mode in vitest unit tests, (4) record/replay against the SDK boundary via vitest module mocks. The SDK already accepts baseUrl via GammaClientConfig; CLI would need GAMMA_BASE_URL wired through makeClient(). Defer until there's a real ask for CI-level generate flow coverage.

No half-implementation — followed brief's defer rule. Follow-up: gamma-cli-1ye.
